info.name: RAG Content Generator API
info.description: Postman collection for session + generation APIs (6 core routes). Includes output-format examples sourced from text_output folder.

request.description: Creates a new session and returns session_id.
Uploads chapter content and builds chunks/vector store.
Deletes a session and all generated files.
Generate a full question paper using PaperBlueprint.
